subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c67f56ffc2d077972aca2cf4852162dba8ef2e81e7af3347caf066ab81da1ee.png]
solution:
**Explanation:**

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The number of lines increases in every step and it moves left to right in the bottom.

 The partial circle moves left to right in the top and it moves clockwise.

 The ring moves clockwise.**

Next step:

 **The number of lines will be 5.

 The partial circle will be at left and face towards right.

 The ring will be at bottom left.**

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) The partial circle is placed incorrectly.

Option 2) The pattern is correct.

Option 3) The partial circle is placed incorrectly.

Option 4) The partial circle is placed incorrectly.

**Hence the correct answer is option 2.**
